tooltip.sable_sublevel_detection.occupan:
§7Provides a redstone output when the sublevel it belongs to is occupied by a player.

Can be inverted when right-clicked with an empty hand.
tooltip.sable_sublevel_detection.seated_:
§7Provides a redstone output when the sublevel it belongs to is occupied by a player who is seated down.

Can be inverted when right-clicked with an empty hand.
